source_note: Static CDS/VizieR catalog archives, not the model team's site: padova/1994 = J/A+AS/106/275 (Bertelli et al. 1994), padova/2000 = J/A+AS/141/371 (Girardi et al. 2000); the original host pleiadi.pd.astro.it is effectively dead. The canonical catalog host (cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr) is unreachable from this network (proxy CONNECT tunnel hangs, verified 2026-11-10); the ADAC mirror's native tree over plain HTTP is the verified channel, and the CfA mirror carries no native tree. Upstream publishes no checksums; the sha256 values below were computed at download and re-verified identical on 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-12.
scope_note: The isochrone tables of each catalog only. The track tables (mstracks, hbtracks), surface-composition tables, SSP integrated colors, and the postscript print versions of the 1994 tables are out of scope: stellariso consumes isochrones, and the pst files are a print rendering of tables already acquired. Both catalogs are acquired whole in their in-scope parts (each directory is well under 5 MB compressed).
excluded: J/A+AS/141/371 mstracks.dat.gz, hbtracks.dat.gz, surfcomp.dat.gz, sspcolor.dat.gz: evolutionary tracks, surface compositions, and SSP colors are out of scope (isochrone product only)
J/A+AS/106/275 z0004.pst..z05.pst: postscript print renderings of table1..table6 (duplicate format of in-scope data)

format_notes.isochrones_2000: isochron.dat: fixed-width Lrecl 142, no comment header; one row per isochrone point, grid axes (Overshoot, Z, age) carried as columns; blocks are consecutive rows of one (Overshoot, Z, age). isochsum.dat: fixed-width Lrecl 94, characteristic points per isochrone with G1 stage labels — the companion the derived phase field requires.
format_notes.isochrones_1994: table1..table6: fixed-width Lrecl 106, no comment header, one file per published (Z, Y); the rows state neither composition nor release — the canonical file names carry the composition per the catalog ReadMe's file list, and ages run oldest-first within each file.

physics.note: single Y per Z (no Z-Y plane in the isochrone tables); table2 from Huebner 1977 opacities, the rest Iglesias 1992

physics.overshoot: 1 across the grid (moderate convective overshoot); 0 = solar-composition comparison set with the classical Schwarzschild criterion
physics.note: one Y per Z (0.23/0.23/0.24/0.25/0.273/0.30; solar = [Z=0.019, Y=0.273] per the ReadMe); log(age) 7.80-10.25 step 0.05 per (Overshoot, Z)
